exposure: time since discharge from birth hospitalization
outcome: outpatient encounters (emergency department, obstetric triage, urgent care)
cohort: A retrospective cohort of 6,041 birthing people aged >=18 years who delivered >=1 liveborn infant >20 weeks of gestation between July 1, 2021, and December 31, 2022, from a quaternary maternity hospital in the Southeastern United States.
finding: 11.3% of the cohort had at least one outpatient encounter and 3.2% had at least one hospital readmission within 12 weeks of discharge, with complications during puerperium and hypertension being the two most frequent indications for PACU.
followup_time: 12 weeks after discharge from birth hospitalization
